---
title: "naturtiltak"
format: html
---

```{r}
akershus <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/AdministrativeUnits/Norway_AdministrativeUnits/Original/Norway_County/versjon2024/Administrative_enheter_fylker_2024_FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_Fylker2024_FGDB.gdb", layer="fylke")

```

```{r}
punkt_url <- paste0(
  # Alle punkter: 0
  "https://kart3.miljodirektoratet.no/arcgis/rest/services/naturtiltak/naturtiltak/MapServer/0/query?",
  "where=1%3D1&",
  "outFields=*&",
  "returnGeometry=true&",
  "f=geojson"
)

punkt <- st_read(punkt_url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(25832) %>%
  # Velg kun de innenfor Akershus
  st_filter(akershus, .predicate = st_within)

linje_url <- paste0(
  # Lokalt og regionalt: 2
  "https://kart3.miljodirektoratet.no/arcgis/rest/services/naturtiltak/naturtiltak/MapServer/2/query?",
  "where=1%3D1&",
  "outFields=*&",
  "returnGeometry=true&",
  "f=geojson"
)

linje <- st_read(linje_url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(25832) %>%
  # Velg kun de innenfor Akershus
  st_filter(akershus, .predicate = st_within)

polygon_url <- paste0(
  # Lokalt og regionalt: 5
  "https://kart3.miljodirektoratet.no/arcgis/rest/services/naturtiltak/naturtiltak/MapServer/5/query?",
  "where=1%3D1&",
  "outFields=*&",
  "returnGeometry=true&",
  "f=geojson"
)

polygon <- st_read(polygon_url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(25832) %>%
  # Velg kun de innenfor Akershus
  st_filter(akershus, .predicate = st_within)


```

## Eksporter

```{r}
temp_file <- "~/Mounts/scratch/tmp_ida/gpkg/naturtiltak.gpkg" 
final_file <- "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Tilleggsdata/naturtiltak.gpkg" 
st_write(polygon, temp_file, layer = "naturtiltak_polygoner", append=F)
st_write(linje, temp_file, layer = "naturtiltak_linjer", append=F)
st_write(punkt, temp_file, layer = "naturtiltak_punkter", append=F)

file.copy(temp_file, final_file, overwrite = TRUE)

```
